_about.explicit: Always scanned, and a repository here that cannot be read stops the run. GIAP's curated llama.cpp picks and the Gemma 4 E2B, E4B and 12B builds, qat and not. Each gets the plain directory name (the repository name in lower case, without -GGUF).
_about.families: Searched under each author, by downloads. A result is kept when its name starts with the search term, allowing only an upstream_orgs prefix before it.
_about.authors: Publishers whose GGUF uploads are trusted. Lines already in the table from these publishers are rescanned even when a search no longer returns them.
_about.upstream_orgs: Organisations a re-uploader may put before a name, as bartowski does (google_gemma-3-4b-it). Any other prefix marks a third-party fine-tune, which is left out.
_about.search_limit: Results taken from each family and author search.
